description: A state that applies immediately. If it needs a Save button it is a checkbox in a form, not a switch.

MUST: Apply its change on release, with no confirmation step and no save action.
Meet the density minimum through hit slop, keeping the track at its own size.
Move its thumb on the indicator role — a curve, not a spring. It is chrome, and chrome is calm.
Fire the selection haptic on change.
Expose itself as a switch with its current state, and carry a label even when the row beside it has one.
Derive its thumb size and travel from the track and the inset, so the three cannot drift apart.
SHOULD: Keep its label in the row that hosts it rather than inside the control.
Mirror its travel under right-to-left rather than restating the geometry.
NEVER: Pair with a Save button. That is a checkbox.
Scale the visual up to meet the target.
Animate the thumb on a spring.
